column1: # The decklist import alias table (Decklist Import, spec "The import alias table"; ticket #213): set codes as pasted
# decklists write them that the printed set code table (set_codes.tsv) doesn't hold, each with the TCGdex set it names.
# Only api/app/import_aliases.py reads it, to match a pasted line and to fill a Missing cards report. Nothing reads it
# for exports, Format Standing or public records, and it never feeds the Live export table
# (catalog_targets.LiveRulesV1.SET_CODES). api/tests/test_import_aliases.py enforces that and the rules below.
# Rule for a row: at least one source shows decklists writing the code (F, L, O or V), and a row with a number prefix
# also cites X. This table records pasted forms, not printed codes, so it doesn't follow set_codes.tsv's two-source
# rule. Game-only codes (SVALT, SWSHALT) get no row: they name no printed card, so their lines fall through to Basic
# Energy by type or to the name.
# Source keys:
#   F  Limitless's deck-page clipboard formatter writes this code (decklist-11f9e903.js, read 2026-10-14;
#      docs/planning/decklist-import/wayfinder/research/set-code-mapping.md, section 2)
#   L  Limitless's card database set list, https://limitlesstcg.com/cards (read 2026-10-14): Limitless's own code
#   O  a Pokémon TCG Online export writes this code (research decklist-text-formats.md, fixture F7)
#   V  a TCG Live-shaped export writes this code (research decklist-text-formats.md, fixtures F1, F2, F6 and F9)
#   X  TCGdex numbers the set's cards with this prefix: SWSH001, SM01, CC001 (research set-code-mapping.md, section 3)
# Number rules:
#   add   the prefix goes before a pasted number that is digits only ("PR-SW 281" is SWSH281); a number that already
#         starts with it is kept ("PR-SM SM62")
#   only  the row applies only to a pasted number that starts with the prefix ("CEL CC1" is Classic Collection CC001;
#         "CEL 24" stays Celebrations through set_codes.tsv)
#   -     the number as pasted
# Numbers then compare as catalog search compares them (zeros after a number's letters don't count). The -TG/-GG/-RC
# split and the Shining Vault flat numbers are rules in import_aliases.py, not rows.
# Columns, tab-separated: pasted code, TCGdex set ID, number prefix (or -), number rule, sources.
